caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object with a silver or metallic blue body featuring vertical ridges on the upper curved surface. Inside this cylinder, positioned centrally, is a brownish rectangular candle with a visible wick at the top. The candle sits on a flat, circular silver or blue base that forms the bottom part of the cylinder. The drawing uses shades of purple, blue, and brown, with some areas shaded to indicate dimension and light. The object casts a light purple shadow to the right, extending horizontally and downward. The background is plain, off-white, and the lower right corner of the paper contains small text that reads "W 70 BURN."
title: Candle Holder
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
